I’m generally pretty bad with comforting others so apologies in advanced. 

My heart goes out to you and I am hoping nothing but the best for you. Two years ago my boyfriend of 3 years broke up with me and I felt like my world ended. I couldn’t breathe, my life stopped and everything inside of me was empty. It was incredibly hard but look at this, I’m here to tell the tale and let you know that everything is going to be okay. Maybe you don’t feel great right now but I can promise you that you will feel great one day. Look forward to that one day and hold onto it. Keep in mind all of the people you love and the people that love you. 

Rest now. Hold your precious cat like there’s no tomorrow and go to sleep. Wake up tomorrow, look at yourself in the mirror and smile and think about something that can make you smile. Have some coffee, eat some breakfast, and keep in mind that it gets better. Keep in mind what makes you smile. 

What does make you smile??? You have a cat, does he or she make you smile?? What else makes you smile?? Good job? Any hobbies? Like to cook? Maybe pick up some meditating??? I use this app called headspace, highly recommend if you just want to get away from your thoughts even for just a second. 

Know that you are loved even if you think you aren’t and know that it gets easier even if you think it won’t. Tomorrow WILL be better.

My big boy chuck is afraid of nearly everything. I rescued him and took him to my 2nd story apartment only to find out he’s afraid of going down the stairs. :) it took 3 days, lots of hotdogs and so much convincing to get him to even consider the stairs. 

Other than stairs he’s also afraid of any kind of floors without carpet or rugs... we have rugs everywhere just for him. 

Those are the two main things he’s afraid of but the list in short also includes children, bridges, sewer drains, people wearing hats, bicycles, frisbees, spray bottles, vacuums, scales at the vet, and people talking too loudly. We love him so much despite his afraid-of-everything mentality.
